purpose: Adapt four embedded business-course infographics to fictional optometry and laboratory workshop activities.

edits.prompt:
Use case: text-localization / infographic-diagram. Edit target: the supplied three-column infographic. Patch it for the 中華醫事科技大學 AI Agent workshop for beginner optometry and medical laboratory students. Keep landscape 3:2 composition, cream background, navy typography, blue Chat / teal Work / orange Codex panels, friendly students and robot, polished educational illustration style and large readable Traditional Chinese text. Replace ALL retail/discount/customer examples.
Title verbatim: "AI 的三種工作角色"; subtitle: "醫事課堂：依任務與成果選擇工作方式".
Chat panel: "Chat", "對話・解釋・討論"; show two students discussing a simple volume diagram; exact example "解釋最終體積與稀釋液體積"; display "5 mL + 20 mL = 25 mL"; output "回答與想法"; check "對照講義，用自己的話說明".
Work panel: "Work", "依來源整理多步任務"; show fictional group meeting notes becoming a todo table, NO clinical records or real personal data; exact example "整理虛構小組會議，產出待辦表"; table headers "工作項目" "負責人" "期限"; an unresolved table entry "待確認"; output "可保存的文件"; check "逐列核對來源，不補造資料".
Codex panel: "Codex", "製作或修改數位工具"; show laptop with two small browser cards labelled "視光處方轉換器" and "醫檢稀釋換算器", generic input fields and calculate button "計算"; no discount calculator; output "可操作的網頁與專案"; check "親自操作，手算核對".
Footer verbatim: "Chat 與 Work 都可能處理檔案；依任務與交付成果選擇。" and "僅供虛構課堂練習，成果由你核對。".
No misleading ranking, no platform capability guarantees, no clinical recommendations. Prioritize accurate and readable Chinese, generous spacing, simplify illustrations to fit. Preserve the visual family of the reference.
edits.correction_prompt:
Edit the supplied infographic precisely. Keep its overall layout, palette, characters, all correct large labels and footer unchanged. Fix ONLY these errors:
1) Chat lower example line must read exactly "解釋最終體積與稀釋液體積", including final 積. In the speech bubble render "5 mL + 20 mL = 25 mL" consistently.
2) Work small table must match the fictional workshop meeting source, not invented names/dates. Header "工作項目 | 負責人 | 期限". Four rows "手算案例 | 組員甲 | 實作前", "欄位與單位 | 組員乙 | 待確認", "錯填測試 | 待確認 | 待確認", "整理截圖 | 待確認 | 待確認". The paper meeting notes can be short lines "手算案例", "欄位與單位", "錯填測試", "整理截圖". No names or dates beyond source.
3) Codex browser must be the ACTUAL two workshop calculators. Left title "視光處方轉換器". Input display "S -2.00 D" "C -1.00 D" "A 180°". Below arrow result "-3.00 D / +1.00 D × 90°", button "轉換". Do not convert D to mm. Right title "醫檢稀釋換算器", input "C₁ 10 mg/mL" "C₂ 2 mg/mL" "V₂ 25 mL", output "原液 5 mL" "稀釋液 20 mL", button "計算". Make browser bigger and remove unnecessary lower duplicate example text if needed to ensure readable exact labels. No newly invented clinical or medical values.
Keep all other typography and artwork. Traditional Chinese only for prose.

edits.prompt:
Use case: text-localization / infographic-diagram. Edit target: supplied four-column requirement infographic. Adapt to beginner optometry/laboratory AI Agent workshop, replacing all retail/store/inventory material with classroom dilution calculator. Keep cream background, dark navy bold Traditional Chinese, friendly cartoon students, four numbered cards blue/teal/cyan/orange, landscape 3:2 layout. Remove the old "02" heading number because the handout section differs.
Title "把醫事想法寫成清楚的需求"; subtitle "先說清楚目標、使用者、成果與驗收".
Card 1 "目標"; question "要解決什麼問題？"; example "依課堂公式做稀釋換算"; illustration student with fictional worksheet.
Card 2 "使用情境"; question "誰會使用？在哪裡用？"; example "醫檢系學生，在筆電上練習"; illustration ordinary student at laptop in classroom, no store apron.
Card 3 "預期成果"; question "輸入什麼？顯示什麼？"; example "輸入 C₁、C₂、V₂"; next line "顯示原液與稀釋液體積"; illustrate simple calculator with units mL and concentration fields.
Card 4 "完成條件與界線"; question "怎樣算完成？哪些不做？"; three concise lines "手算一致" "錯填有提示" "離線可用、只用虛構資料".
Bottom compare speech bubbles: red badge "太簡略"; quote "幫我做一個稀釋工具。". teal badge "更清楚"; quote "給醫檢系學生練習；輸入同單位濃度與最終體積；顯示原液與稀釋液體積；手算核對。". Small separate footer "C₁、V₂ > 0；0 < C₂ ≤ C₁；C₂ = C₁ 時不需稀釋。" plus "僅供課堂計算練習。".
Avoid laboratory operating steps, clinical interpretation, retail goods. Make text exact, readable and balanced. Do not add another section number.

Use case: text-localization / infographic-diagram. Edit target: supplied four-stage workflow infographic. Adapt it to the actual optometry/laboratory AI Agent workshop. Preserve landscape 3:2 proportions, four colorful cards blue/teal/amber/orange, cream background, navy large Traditional Chinese typography, friendly beginner students with laptops, left-to-right arrows, loop for improvement. Remove "03" heading prefix.
Title "醫事實作：從交辦到驗收"; subtitle "選一題完成，再用手算與實際操作核對".
Stage 1 "題目敘述"; subtitle "選一題，看懂需求"; two visible worksheet tags "視光處方轉換器" and "醫檢稀釋換算器".
Stage 2 "建議 Prompt"; subtitle "用自己的話交辦"; checklist "使用者、輸入、規則、輸出、驗收"; student gives task via laptop.
Stage 3 "預期成果"; subtitle "先寫下手算答案"; show a fictional calculator expectation card with exact text "C₁ = 10 mg/mL" "C₂ = 2 mg/mL" "V₂ = 25 mL" "原液 5 mL；稀釋液 20 mL". Keep units and values consistent, no physical lab operating depiction.
Stage 4 "完成檢核"; subtitle "親自操作，核對數字"; three check rows "正常案例" "空白與錯填" "邊界條件".
Bottom feedback loop text verbatim "記錄落差 → 說清楚問題 → 修改後再測", arrow returns from stage 4 toward stage 2, not toward a new unrelated task. Bottom small badges "短版 → 完整版 → 改進版" and "三個版本各自保留"; footer "只用虛構課堂資料，計算结果由你核對。" Use Traditional Chinese 結果 instead of simplified character 结果.
No charts irrelevant to calculations, no retail setting, no diagnoses or clinical claims. Large short labels, clear expected-answer card.
